args: sam toMultiAlign -s aln.sam --start 100 --end 20
exit: 1
--- stderr
Error: --start must not be after --end (got 100 and 20)
Usage:
  gofasta sam toMultiAlign [flags]

Aliases:
  toMultiAlign, tomultialign, toma

Flags:
      --start int        1-based first position (in reference coordinates) to keep in the output. Bases before it are omitted, or replaced with N if --pad (default -1)
      --end int          1-based last position (in reference coordinates) to keep in the output. Bases after it are omitted, or replaced with N if --pad (default -1)
  -w, --wrap int         Wrap the output alignment to this number of nucleotides wide. Omit this option not to wrap the output. (default -1)
      --pad              If --start and/or --end, replace the trimmed-out regions with Ns, else replace external deletions with Ns
  -o, --outfile string   Where to write the alignment (default "stdout")
      --strict           Stop with an error at the first record that can't be processed, instead of warning and skipping it
  -h, --help             help for toMultiAlign

Global Flags:
  -r, --reference string   Reference fasta file used to generate the sam file
  -s, --samfile string     SAM file to read (default "stdin")
  -t, --threads int        Number of threads (and CPUs) to use: 0, the default, for all of them
